notes.title: Tutorial update, journal UI fix, better corruption handling, etc.
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New invitation for players to customize their character during the initial tutorial.
[*] Rebalanced distribution of opportunities to start new conversations.
[*] Fixed a bug that would show the wrong menu if you opened the journal and the closed it really fast.
[*] Improved handling of corrupted cache files.
[*] Upgraded the engine to Unity version 6 from Unity version 2022. 
[/list]

I'm not sure Unity knows how numbers work because that's would seem to imply I've reduced Unity by 2,016 Unities. I'm sure it will be fine. We didn't need all those Unity's anyways. 

I think.

More importantly, checkout our sweet new trailer.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2118120/view/508449788991111875

notes.title: Bug fixes and traps
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New: You can delete messages you receive in your inboxes.
[*] Fixed: Multiple issues viewing inboxes while offline.
[*] Fixed: The favorites button getting stuck down while viewing wishes
[*] Trap: Several better debugging tools to help me figure out some mysteries. Like why loading the chain forest locks up the game for some people.
[/list]

If you encounter something that makes you have to force quit the game: A) I'm very sorry. B) If you restart the game to submit feedback and you choose to attach an anonymized log, I'll also get the log for the previous session where the bad thing happened.

Thanks!

notes.title: Release Date: October 7th, 2024
notes.notes:
This week marks the 5 year anniversary of launching Kind Words on Steam. A lot has changed in 5 years, hasn't it? Not just for the world, but for you personally, I'll bet.

One of my biggest changes was having Kind Words in my life. It's been an amazing trip for Luigi and I to learn how to care for this community we started. And what a joy it has been that the community has cared for us in return.

I could go on all sentimental like for a while, but I've got to go fix bugs now to make everything ready for the launch day. 

You watch this shiny new trailer, share it with all your friends and I'll get back to writing code. Deal? Deal.


[previewyoutube=Zo8fzStygUo;full][/previewyoutube]

Yours,
Ziba & Luigi

notes.title: Development Update: June 17th, 2024
notes.notes:
One focus of our work right now is to balance vibes across the multiple spaces and activities. The mountain top area is our outdoor quiet space. A spot for calm and grand reflection.

Here you will find the hot springs. While soaking their stresses away, players are invited to share pro-tips for good living. You can just listen or join in with your own suggestions.

[previewyoutube=q2hng55ZgxQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Development Update: June 4th, 2024
notes.notes:
We've been doing development updates in our discord for a while and thought folks over in Steam might like to see them too. Yeah? Here goes!

Kind Words 2 is all about communicating with real people in different forms, and poetry is a fun form.

You can read and write poetry in the cafe. In this update we show how you can also request poetry from other people on specific topics as well as see and fulfill other people's topic requests.
